title: Oura Ring footer
description: A warm near-black footer on a soft diagonal gradient: a large light wordmark and a row of small white payment chips, a stone-grey editorial-serif newsletter line with a rounded email field, four link columns (stone headings, cream links, small arrows on outside links), then a hairline, small legal links, the copyright and a round outlined language pill. On phones the payment chips take turns in two groups with a caption, crossfading in a loop.
notes: dark-scoped (class dark): stays a near-black footer under any theme
overlap tucks it 40px under a block with rounded bottom corners (the press band)
payment chips take any icon; use plain icons or text, not third-party logos you don't have rights to
CSS only; with reduced motion the phone payment groups sit one above the other
name: ouraring-footer

props.name: logo
props.description: the wordmark, set large and light

props.name: payments
props.description: one or two payment groups; on phones two groups crossfade in turn

props.name: newsletter
props.type: { title: ReactNode; placeholder: string; submitLabel: string; action?: string | undefined; note?: ReactNode; }

props.name: legal
props.description: small links in the bottom row

props.name: overlap
props.description: tuck 40px under the block before it (one with rounded bottom corners)
